author: kesudh
method: Exact shortest-path-tree warm refinement: radix A*, feasible per-sink bounds, neutral and group reroutes, preserved-route and displacement-chain repair, optional circular integer buckets, multiple CPU search workers, strict final-walk polishing, and exact two-parent minimum-cut crossover following PR24. GPU kernels are audited prototypes and did not generate these routes.
runtime: Measured incremental refinement only: complete native processes including parsing/checking, search and output, plus independent checker loading and validation. Every private parent stage is charged recursively. Excludes generation of public warm starts, compilation, persistent-harness interpreter imports, and the exploratory/tuning campaign. This is not a from-scratch runtime comparison.
runtime_hardware: Windows, Intel i7-13700HX, 16 cores/24 threads; actual worker count recorded per command; concurrent Hermes and benchmark workloads. Observed wall times, not normalized.
selection: Best independently legal output per case; ties select shortest measured invocation. The per-case commands disclose benchmark-specific selection. Timed multiworker search is nondeterministic.
